title: The guard refuses a python3 -c or heredoc script that writes to a frozen file
why: Main lets a `python3 -c` or heredoc script write to a frozen file, which the frozen-path guard refuses for a shell write (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 06:28 CST Nov 8).
note: Red rows on branch frozen-python-writes (22bccac1a). Held until the env-file-shell-c lane's interpreter-code reader PR exists; then it builds on that reader (one home for interpreter code, coordinator 06:26 CST; owner items 386, 410 a and 399 a). Lane session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85. Filed 06:47 CST Nov 8. Possible false alarm for this step's reverse case (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), 08:58 CST Nov 8; reader not traced): at about 14:56Z a read-only probe, `python3 -I -c` that imports guard_frozen and passes strings naming the installed verdict wrapper to frozen_shell_hit, was refused as a frozen-path write. Triage's own heredoc that named the same path in step text was refused the same way at 09:05 CST. The guard this step builds must still pass a script that only names a frozen path (see done step frozen-path-string-note).
